about: A note's name (plain text) as the base of a file name Windows accepts: \ / : * ? " < > | as their full-width forms (＼ ／ ： ＊ ？ ＂ ＜ ＞ ｜); runs of white space as one space; C0 control characters and DEL removed; trimmed; leading dots as full-width dots (．); cut to at most `max` UTF-16 code units (as Windows counts a name; default 120) without splitting a character; then trailing dots and spaces removed; a reserved device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0-9, LPT0-9, any case, before the first dot) gets '_' after it. '' when nothing is left. input: { name, max? } → expected string.
